# Athena - AI Operations Platform
# https://athena.dev
# Curated index for LLM agents and AI-powered search

## Overview
> Site URL: https://athena.dev/
> Description: AI proxy + observability + evaluation platform with closed-loop workflow for agentic AI

## Core Concepts
- Athena is an AI proxy + observability + evaluation platform
- Closed-loop workflow: Logs → Dataset → Experiment
- Session-first data model for agent runs
- Graph debugging for visualizing agent execution
- Semantic-first evaluation (LLM judge, criteria-based, tool correctness)
- MCP server for IDE integration (Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code)

## API Reference
https://athena.dev/api/

## Key Features
- Universal Proxy: Provider-agnostic LLM inference with SSE streaming
- Agent-Native Observability: Sessions, runs, traces, spans, graph views
- Semantic Evaluation: LLM judge, criteria checklist, tool correctness, outcome scoring
- IDE Integration: MCP server for direct IDE agent access
- Data Isolation: Optional customer-owned data plane
